lines.zh: 冠饰在日光下泛着赤红
lines.en: My crest glows crimson in the sun.
Patrolling the ridge that is mine.
Three-toed feet, almost silent.
Slipping along the shrub line.

lines.zh: 尾巴左右摆动保持平衡
lines.en: My tail swings to hold my balance.
Walking upwind, tasting your scent.
Gravel crunches beneath my claws.
My packmates trail behind me.
Ducking under a fallen trunk.
I know every fern smell here.
Every step tests the ground.
The crest on my snout rocks as I go.
Skirting the mud, choosing dry ground.
Past the fence line, and nothing stops me.
Standing still, only my eyes move.

lines.zh: 把冠饰对准来风的方向
lines.en: Turning my crest into the breeze.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚着低低的咕噜
lines.en: A low rumble rolls in my throat.
Scraping the dirt with one foot.

lines.zh: 盯着灌木里的一点动静
lines.en: Watching a twitch in the bushes.
Waiting for the pack to move first.
Tilting my head at a distant sound.
The sun has warmed my spine.
Flicking my tail lazily.
Tucked away behind the ferns.
My breathing is nearly silent.
A lizard scurries past my foot.
Sniffing iron on the air.
Patience is a hunter's first lesson.
Lowering my head to meet your eyes.
My crest twitches as I size you up.
You carry a smell I don't know.
Turning sideways, watching your hands.
Letting out a short warning cry.
Shifting half a step toward your feet.

lines.zh: 四十格内，同类都会听见我。
lines.en: Within forty blocks, my kin all hear me.
You are standing on my ground.
Sniffing the soles of your boots.
Head tilted, measuring the distance.
My growl drops another note.
Eyes on you, then on your companions.
That hurts! My crest is bent.
You actually hit back.
The smell of my own blood excites me.
I'll remember that one.
Half a step back, then I bite again.
The cut on my flank is shallow.
That roar was pain, not anger.
Now you've stirred up my packmates.
My legs are shaking a little.
Don't think that wins you anything.
Meat! Even my crest stands up.
Is that raw meat meant for me?
The smell of blood roots my feet.
Closer now. Just a little closer.
One bite is enough to tear it open.
My packmates are eyeing that meat too.

lines.zh: 骨头才是最好嚼的部分
lines.en: Bones are the best part to crunch.
Don't back away with that meat.
My drool is dripping onto the dirt.
Me first. We can talk after.
Bumping into me? Wrong choice.
Back off, my crest will cut you.
A shoulder shove sends you back.
Who touched my tail?
Mind my toes.
That counts as a challenge.
Steady there, not so close.

lines.zh: 我的冠擦过你，算是警告。
lines.en: My crest brushed you; that's a warning.
You dared to shove me?
The whole pack is watching this.
The brighter the crest, the better.
Pacing twice in front of my mate.
Nosing the side of her neck.
A low call brings her closer.
We guard this nesting ground together.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴碰了碰她的冠。
lines.en: I brushed her crest with my tail.
She wants to see me hunt first.
This clutch will need warm soil.
Crests touch. That is the promise.
Two hunters are twice the trouble.
I pick the bone up in my jaws.
Dragging it home to gnaw in peace.
That meat is mine now.
I can watch the path while carrying it.
Stashing it under the ferns first.
Juice runs down my jaw.
Picking it up beats chasing it.
Too small. Barely a snack.
Bringing it home for the hatchlings.
Hard to talk with this in my mouth.
You moved. I saw it.
The scent matches. It's you.
Quills flare up. You're marked.
That roar reaches the whole pack.
Within forty blocks my kin wake up.
I take the first step.
Don't run. Running makes it worse.
My gaze nails itself to you.
Crouch, coil, one last look at you.
You walked into my hunting ground.
My teeth are already showing.
A packmate circles your flank.
I can smell the fear on you.
We begin at exactly this distance.
Circling you, hunting an angle.
You go left. So do I.
Closing that gap, step by step.
Watching your feet, not your face.
A packmate waits on the far side.
You're breathing harder than I am.
Tightening the circle a little more.
Trees won't hide you from me.
My stamina lasts longer than you think.
The tip of my tail keeps twitching.
I see it the moment you raise that bow.
I know this ground better than you do.
The pack's footsteps are getting closer.
You've backed up to the water.
I wait for you to make a mistake.
My jaws snap at your calf.
Claws first, then teeth.
A body check, then a bite.
I lunge in from your flank.
My crest slams into your chest.
That bite caught nothing but air.
Once I bite, I don't let go.
My claws pin down your shadow.
My tail sweeps across your knees.
A packmate bites you from behind.
Ten points of pain to remember me by.
You blocked part of that.
Step back further and my teeth still reach.
The growl never leaves my throat.
I rise out of the ferns.
Mud still clings to my claws.
This forest has a new master.
Shaking the leaves off my back.
My crest catches the first light.
A packmate answers from far off.
The gap in the fence closes behind me.
The air here smells new to me.
One track after another, I leave them.
My kin are waking up right here.
Looking up, the trees are so tall.
My first roar splits the quiet.
There are humans close by.
Climbing out of a fissure below.
First, a high perch to survey.
The muscles along my spine tighten.
I memorize this land.
The hunting ground starts now.
Flames lick across the side of my neck.
Dropped from a height, my bones throb.
Water rushes up my snout and I panic.
The blast throws me onto my side.
An arrow buries itself in my shoulder.
This burning feels wrong, unlike fire.
Hunger drags my crest down.
The lightning leaves me numb all over.
The ground beneath my feet is gone.
